verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Docusaurus builds static files into a `build` directory, which can be deployed to hosts such as Vercel, GitHub Pages and Netlify. Custom-domain mapping there is a host-platform capability, and nothing in the pack documents a Docusaurus setting (such as a base URL) for serving docs on a custom domain or under a /docs subpath. Static output is only an adjacent building block, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I serve docs on my own custom domain or as a /docs subpath of my main site
